name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3419: REG-1146. The second eye looked at v3417 at full reach and returned 7 findings; 4 real ones are fixed here, 1 refuted. TWO OF THEM REOPENED THE EXACT CLASS v3417 HAD JUST CLOSED. (1) v3417 added _hrtSawCensus so a failed fetch could not un-take a census that had arrived - correct, and too broad: it suppressed EVERY later non-census paint, so after one real census a payload of ok true with empty counts left the clean face up while the doctor called that same payload MISSING. A failed FETCH is SILENCE; a payload that came back carrying nothing is an ANSWER, and the answer is that there is no census. (2) AND THE JOIN COULD NOT HAVE CAUGHT IT: test_THE_JOIN drove each payload in a FRESH node process so the latched state was never reached - it graded the stateless half and reported agreement. It now replays SEQUENCES. A corroborator that cannot reach the stateful path is a corroborator for the easy case. (3) an absent key coerced back to a measured zero: counts with only FLOWING passed the census test and c.DARK or 0 turned the MISSING key into a clean heart, while the doctor printed a question mark for the same key; the chip now reads question-mark dark, and a real zero still reads heart. (4) an UNKNOWN fingerprint field exempted the WHOLE row, so head concrete and origin UNKNOWN reported agreement while the stored head disagreed with git outright; a field nobody could measure is UNKNOWN, a field that WAS measured and differs is a difference, and one does not excuse the other. (5) the OK reason always ended with so the sentence is true, including on files carrying no all-clear claim at all. Also: the false-all-clear verdict now says its three figures come from THREE SEPARATE git reads, and the stylesheet check strips block comments to 60000 chars plus HTML and slash-slash forms. REFUTED: the eye reported the data-untaken rule missing; it is at control_ui.html line 6208 and the payload strips comment-only lines. Gates: 22 cases with 9 RED_PROOFs and 17 cases with 5 RED_PROOFs, all PROVEN. heart2 refused one of my own proofs as INVALID at 0 matches because v3419 rewrote the line it anchored on - a red-proof drifts exactly when the code it guards improves, and only the match count says so.
